title: Cancellation Ladder and Administration Charge, Vacation Package Products
content:
The cancellation penalty published against each of the Vacation Package Products is a share of the package price, keyed by how far ahead of departure the cancellation lands. Alongside the ladder each product publishes a non-refundable administration charge per traveller on any cancellation, and whether the deposit itself is returned when the package is cancelled before the balance is due.

## The ladder, as a share of the package price

| Product | 90 or more days before departure | 89 to 43 days | 42 to 15 days | 14 or fewer days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 25 per cent | 50 per cent | 75 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Flex Bundle Package | 15 per cent | 35 per cent | 60 per cent | 100 per cent |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 20 per cent | 45 per cent | 70 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Escorted Tour Package | 25 per cent | 55 per cent | 80 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 30 per cent | 60 per cent | 85 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Luxury Collection Package | 10 per cent | 30 per cent | 55 per cent | 90 per cent |

The four bands are contiguous and leave no day uncovered: a cancellation landing exactly 90 days before departure falls in the first band, one landing exactly 89 days in the second, one landing exactly 43 days still in the second, one landing exactly 42 days in the third, one landing exactly 15 days still in the third, and one landing 14 days or fewer in the last.

## Administration charge and the deposit

| Product | Cancellation administration per traveller | Deposit returned before the balance falls due |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 75.00 USD | not returned |
| Flex Bundle Package | 60.00 USD | not returned |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 75.00 USD | not returned |
| Escorted Tour Package | 100.00 USD | not returned |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 125.00 USD | not returned |
| Luxury Collection Package | 50.00 USD | returned |

The Luxury Collection Package is the one product of the six whose deposit is refundable, and it is also the only one whose last ladder band stops short of the whole package price, at 90 per cent. On every other product the last band stands at 100 per cent.
